comp3.title: Research Domains
comp3.description: Following are the Research Domains Of GNSS Research Lab:

cards.title: GNSS Constellations and Orbit Design
cards.description: Regional and global constellation analysis, optimisation, coverage and geometry assessment.

cards.title: GNSS Signals and Receiver Systems
cards.description: Signal generation, acquisition, tracking, navigation data processing and software-defined receivers.

cards.title: Positioning and Estimation
cards.description: Single-point positioning, differential GNSS, RTK, network RTK, PPP and estimation algorithms.

cards.title: GNSS Augmentation
cards.description: Ground- and space-based augmentation, correction services, integrity and performance monitoring.

cards.title: Resilient and Secure PNT
cards.description: Jamming, spoofing, fault detection, interference mitigation, integrity and alternative PNT.

cards.title: GNSS and Inertial Integration
cards.description: Multi-sensor navigation, GNSS/INS integration, attitude determination and autonomous systems.

cards.title: Ionosphere and Space Weather
cards.description: TEC, scintillation, ionospheric modelling, geomagnetic effects and signal-propagation studies.

cards.title: GNSS Remote Sensing
cards.description: Reflectometry, environmental sensing, atmospheric studies and GNSS-based radar concepts.

cards.title: GNSS Applications and Services
cards.description: Transport, agriculture, surveying, telecommunications, smart infrastructure and location-based services.

comp4.title: Research Projects
comp4.description: Following are the research projects Of GNSS Research Lab

cards.title: Academic and Research GNSS CORS Network
cards.description: Development of a reference-station network for precise positioning, geodetic research, education and correction-service experimentation.

cards.title: GNSS Digital Observatory
cards.description: A visual platform for satellite visibility, signal quality, positioning performance, constellation status and receiver-health analytics.

cards.title: Space Weather and Ionospheric Observatory
cards.description: Local GNSS and GISTM observations integrated with authoritative datasets to study TEC, scintillation and space-weather impacts.

cards.title: Regional Navigation Satellite Constellation Design
cards.description: Optimization of satellite constellations for Pakistan and regional service areas using geometry, availability and multi-objective design criteria.

cards.title: Resilient PNT and GNSS Security
cards.description: Detection and mitigation of jamming, spoofing, signal anomalies and integrity risks in GNSS-dependent systems.

cards.title: Low-Cost Precise Positioning
cards.description: Evaluation and development of cost-effective receiver configurations for DGPS, RTK, PPP and CORS applications.

cards.title: GNSS/INS and Attitude Determination
cards.description: Integrated navigation and platform-attitude solutions using GNSS measurements, inertial sensors and estimation methods.

cards.title: GNSS Remote Sensing and Environmental Applications
cards.description: Research on GNSS reflectometry, soil moisture, atmospheric conditions and signal-based sensing applications.

comp5.title: Publications
comp5.description: The lab's research outputs include peer-reviewed journal articles, conference papers, technical studies and supervised theses. The website should provide searchable records with filters for year, research domain, author, output type and open-access availability. Types of Publications Include: Journal publications, Conference publications, MS research theses.
